about: Tower upgrade trees (decision D055): after level 5 a tower of one of these kinds grows on in two paths of three tiers (path a: it fires faster; path b: it hits harder). One path may reach tier 3; once a path is past tier 1 the other stays at tier 1 at most. A tier needs level 5, the tier before it on its path, the island's best won wave of the campaign id in 'steps' (campaign.json: tree_1, tree_2, tree_3) and its price in coins, paid once by the player who clicks (ledger reason tower_tree, ref towertree:<actionUid>). prices: tiers 1, 2 and 3, the same for both paths of a kind. The numbers the sim fights with, the names and the glyphs are in frontend/src/pirates/tower-trees.js; a frontend test keeps prices, ids and names equal. A kind that is not in the island's catalogue (the culverin while the flag defenses_v2 is off) is skipped.
